name: console.log of querystring.parse and parseArgs results
source: import * as qs from "node:querystring"; import { parseArgs } from "node:util"; function main(): void { console.log(qs.parse("a=1&a=2&b=%20x&c")); console.log(parseArgs({ args: ["-f"], options: { foo: { type: "boolean", short: "f" } } })); }
